verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ זָהָ֔ב יוּעַ֣ם הַטּ֑וֹב הַכֶּ֣תֶם יִשְׁנֶ֖א אַבְנֵי־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֙כְנָה֙ כָּל־ חוּצֽוֹת׃ס בְּרֹ֖אשׁ
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh zā·hāḇ yū·‘am haṭ·ṭō·wḇ hak·ke·ṯem yiš·ne ’aḇ·nê- qō·ḏeš tiš·tap·pê·ḵə·nāh kāl- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ bə·rōš
verses.literal: How the gold has become tarnished the pure gold has become dull The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner

verses.original: אֵיכָ֤ה הַיְקָרִ֔ים בְּנֵ֤י צִיּוֹן֙ הַמְסֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּפָּ֑ז נֶחְשְׁבוּ֙ לְנִבְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יוֹצֵֽר׃ס יְדֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh hay·qā·rîm bə·nê ṣî·yō·wn ham·sul·lā·’îm bap·pāz neḥ·šə·ḇū lə·niḇ·lê- ḥe·reś ma·‘ă·śêh yō·w·ṣêr yə·ḏê
verses.literal: How the precious sons of Zion once worth their weight in pure gold are now esteemed as jars of clay the work of a potter’s hands

verses.original: גַּם־ תַּנִּין חָ֣לְצוּ שַׁ֔ד הֵינִ֖יקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶ֑ן בַּת־ עַמִּ֣י לְאַכְזָ֔ר כִּי עֵנִים בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- tan·nīn ḥā·lə·ṣū šaḏ hê·nî·qū gū·rê·hen baṯ- ‘am·mî lə·’aḵ·zār kī ʿē·nīm bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young [but] the daughter of my people has become cruel like an ostrich in the wilderness

verses.original: יוֹנֵ֛ק לְשׁ֥וֹן דָּבַ֨ק בַּצָּמָ֑א אֶל־ חכּ֖וֹ עֽוֹלָלִים֙ שָׁ֣אֲלוּ לֶ֔חֶם אֵ֥ין לָהֶֽם׃ס פֹּרֵ֖שׂ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·nêq lə·šō·wn dā·ḇaq baṣ·ṣā·mā ’el- ḥ·kō ‘ō·w·lā·lîm šā·’ă·lū le·ḥem ’ên lā·hem pō·rêś
verses.literal: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth Little children beg for bread but no . . . one gives them any

verses.original: הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ לְמַ֣עֲדַנִּ֔ים נָשַׁ֖מּוּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת הָאֱמֻנִים֙ עֲלֵ֣י תוֹלָ֔ע חִבְּק֖וּ אַשְׁפַּתּֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·ḵə·lîm lə·ma·‘ă·ḏan·nîm nā·šam·mū ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ĕ·mu·nîm ‘ă·lê ṯō·w·lā‘ ḥib·bə·qū ’aš·pat·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps

verses.original: עֲוֺ֣ן בַּת־ עַמִּ֔י וַיִּגְדַּל֙ מֵֽחַטַּ֖את סְדֹ֑ם הַֽהֲפוּכָ֣ה כְמוֹ־ רָ֔גַע וְלֹא־ יָדָֽיִם׃ס חָ֥לוּ בָ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·wōn baṯ- ‘am·mî way·yiḡ·dal mê·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ sə·ḏōm ha·hă·p̄ū·ḵāh ḵə·mōw- rā·ḡa‘ wə·lō- yā·ḏā·yim ḥā·lū ḇāh
verses.literal: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than [that] of Sodom which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her

verses.original: נְזִירֶ֙יהָ֙ זַכּ֤וּ מִשֶּׁ֔לֶג צַח֖וּ מֵחָלָ֑ב עֶ֙צֶם֙ אָ֤דְמוּ מִפְּנִינִ֔ים גִּזְרָתָֽם׃ס סַפִּ֖יר
verses.transliteration: nə·zî·re·hā zak·kū miš·še·leḡ ṣa·ḥū mê·ḥā·lāḇ ‘e·ṣem ’ā·ḏə·mū mip·pə·nî·nîm giz·rā·ṯām sap·pîr
verses.literal: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow whiter than milk their bodies were more ruddy than rubies their appearance like sapphires

verses.original: תָּֽאֳרָ֔ם חָשַׁ֤ךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר֙ לֹ֥א נִכְּר֖וּ בַּחוּצ֑וֹת עוֹרָם֙ צָפַ֤ד עַל־ עַצְמָ֔ם הָיָ֥ה יָבֵ֖שׁ כָעֵֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: tā·’o·rām ḥā·šaḵ miš·šə·ḥō·wr lō nik·kə·rū ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ‘ō·w·rām ṣā·p̄aḏ ‘al- ‘aṣ·mām hā·yāh yā·ḇêš ḵā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: But now their appearance is blacker than soot they are not recognized in the streets Their skin has shriveled on their bones it has become as dry as a stick

verses.original: חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב הָיוּ֙ טוֹבִ֤ים מֵֽחַלְלֵ֖י רָעָ֑ב שֶׁ֣הֵ֤ם יָז֙וּבוּ֙ מְדֻקָּרִ֔ים שָׂדָֽי׃ס מִתְּנוּבֹ֖ת
verses.transliteration: ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ hā·yū ṭō·w·ḇîm mê·ḥal·lê rā·‘āḇ še·hêm yā·zū·ḇū mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm śā·ḏāy mit·tə·nū·ḇōṯ
verses.literal: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger who waste away pierced with pain because the fields lack produce

verses.original: יְדֵ֗י רַחֲמָ֣נִיּ֔וֹת נָשִׁים֙ בִּשְּׁל֖וּ יַלְדֵיהֶ֑ן הָי֤וּ לְבָרוֹת֙ לָ֔מוֹ בְּשֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏê ra·ḥă·mā·nî·yō·wṯ nā·šîm biš·šə·lū yal·ḏê·hen hā·yū lə·ḇā·rō·wṯ lā·mōw bə·še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ כִּלָּ֤ה חֲמָת֔וֹ שָׁפַ֖ךְ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּצֶּת־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וַתֹּ֖אכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- kil·lāh ḥă·mā·ṯōw šā·p̄aḵ ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw way·yaṣ·ṣeṯ- ’êš bə·ṣî·yō·wn wat·tō·ḵal yə·sō·w·ḏō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: The LORD - has exhausted His wrath He has poured out His fierce anger He has kindled a fire in Zion and it has consumed her foundations

verses.original: מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֤א הֶאֱמִ֙ינוּ֙ וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י תֵבֵ֑ל כִּ֤י צַ֣ר וְאוֹיֵ֔ב יָבֹא֙ בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵê- ’e·reṣ lō he·’ĕ·mî·nū wə·ḵå̄l yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl kî ṣar wə·’ō·w·yêḇ yā·ḇō bə·ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: The kings of the earth did not believe nor any people of the world that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem

verses.original: מֵֽחַטֹּ֣את נְבִיאֶ֔יהָ עֲוֺנ֖וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֑יהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִ֥ים דַּ֥ם צַדִּיקִֽים׃ס בְּקִרְבָּ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: mê·ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ nə·ḇî·’e·hā ‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ kō·hă·ne·hā haš·šō·p̄ə·ḵîm dam ṣad·dî·qîm bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: [But this was] for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst

verses.original: נָע֤וּ עִוְרִים֙ בַּֽחוּצ֔וֹת נְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ בַּדָּ֑ם בְּלֹ֣א יֽוּכְל֔וּ יִגְּע֖וּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: nā·‘ū ‘iw·rîm ba·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ nə·ḡō·’ă·lū bad·dām bə·lō yū·ḵə·lū yig·gə·‘ū bil·ḇu·šê·hem
verses.literal: They wandered blind in the streets defiled by this blood so that no one dared to touch their garments

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ טָמֵ֞א קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֗מוֹ ס֤וּרוּ ס֙וּרוּ֙ אַל־ תִּגָּ֔עוּ כִּ֥י נָצ֖וּ גַּם־ נָ֑עוּ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אָֽמְרוּ֙ לָגֽוּר׃ס לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יפוּ
verses.transliteration: sū·rū ṭā·mê qā·rə·’ū lā·mōw sū·rū sū·rū ’al- tig·gā·‘ū kî nā·ṣū gam- nā·‘ū bag·gō·w·yim ’ā·mə·rū lā·ḡūr lō yō·w·sî·p̄ū
verses.literal: Go away Unclean men shouted at them Away away Do not touch us So they fled and wandered Among the nations it was said They can stay here no longer

verses.original: פְּנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ חִלְּקָ֔ם לְהַבִּיטָ֑ם לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף כֹהֲנִים֙ לֹ֣א פְּנֵ֤י נָשָׂ֔אוּ זְקֵנִים לֹ֥א חָנָֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: pə·nê Yah·weh ḥil·lə·qām lə·hab·bî·ṭām lō yō·w·sîp̄ ḵō·hă·nîm lō pə·nê nā·śā·’ū zə·qē·nīm lō ḥā·nā·nū
verses.literal: The presence of the LORD has scattered them He regards them no more The priests vvv vvv are shown no honor the elders find no favor

verses.original: עוֹדֵינָה עֵינֵ֔ינוּ תִּכְלֶ֣ינָה הָ֑בֶל אֶל־ עֶזְרָתֵ֖נוּ בְּצִפִּיָּתֵ֣נוּ צִפִּ֔ינוּ אֶל־ גּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ʿō·ḏē·nå̄h ‘ê·nê·nū tiḵ·le·nāh hā·ḇel ’el- ‘ez·rā·ṯê·nū bə·ṣip·pî·yā·ṯê·nū ṣip·pî·nū ’el- gō·w lō yō·wō·ši·a‘
verses.literal: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help We watched from our towers for a nation [that] could not save us

verses.original: צָד֣וּ צְעָדֵ֔ינוּ מִלֶּ֖כֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵ֑ינוּ קִצֵּ֛ינוּ קָרַ֥ב יָמֵ֖ינוּ כִּי־ מָלְא֥וּ קִצֵּֽינוּ׃ס בָ֥א
verses.transliteration: ṣā·ḏū ṣə·‘ā·ḏê·nū mil·le·ḵeṯ bir·ḥō·ḇō·ṯê·nū qiṣ·ṣê·nū qā·raḇ yā·mê·nū kî- mā·lə·’ū qiṣ·ṣê·nū ḇā
verses.literal: They stalked our every step so that we could not walk in our streets Our end drew near our time . . . ran out for our end had come

verses.original: רֹדְפֵ֔ינוּ הָיוּ֙ קַלִּ֤ים מִנִּשְׁרֵ֖י שָׁמָ֑יִם דְּלָקֻ֔נוּ עַל־ הֶהָרִ֣ים אָ֥רְבוּ לָֽנוּ׃ס בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר
verses.transliteration: rō·ḏə·p̄ê·nū hā·yū qal·lîm min·niš·rê šā·mā·yim də·lā·qu·nū ‘al- he·hā·rîm ’ā·rə·ḇū lā·nū bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה מְשִׁ֣יחַ ר֤וּחַ אַפֵּ֙ינוּ֙ נִלְכַּ֖ד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָ֑ם אָמַ֔רְנוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּצִלּ֖וֹ נִֽחְיֶ֥ה בַגּוֹיִֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mə·šî·aḥ rū·aḥ ’ap·pê·nū nil·kaḏ biš·ḥî·ṯō·w·ṯām ’ā·mar·nū ’ă·šer bə·ṣil·lōw niḥ·yeh ḇag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: The LORD’s anointed the breath of our life was captured in their pits We had said of him Under his shadow we will live among the nations

verses.original: שִׂ֤ישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי֙ בַּת־ אֱד֔וֹם יוֹשַׁבְתִּי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ ע֑וּץ כּ֔וֹס תַּעֲבָר־ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ גַּם־ תִּשְׁכְּרִ֖י וְתִתְעָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: śî·śî wə·śim·ḥî baṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm yō·šaḇ·tī bə·’e·reṣ ‘ūṣ kō·ws ta·‘ă·ḇār- ‘ā·la·yiḵ gam- tiš·kə·rî wə·ṯiṯ·‘ā·rî
verses.literal: So rejoice and be glad O Daughter of Edom [you] who dwell in the land of Uz Yet the cup will pass to you as well you will get drunk and expose yourself

verses.original: בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ תַּם־ לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֖יף לְהַגְלוֹתֵ֑ךְ פָּקַ֤ד עֲוֺנֵךְ֙ בַּת־ אֱד֔וֹם גִּלָּ֖ה עַל־ חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn ‘ă·wō·nêḵ tam- lō yō·w·sîp̄ lə·haḡ·lō·w·ṯêḵ pā·qaḏ ‘ă·wō·nêḵ baṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm gil·lāh ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: O Daughter of Zion your punishment is complete He will not prolong your exile But He will punish your iniquity O Daughter of Edom He will expose . . . your sins
